iso27001.name: Protection of records
iso27001.text: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release in accordance with legislative, regulatory, contractual, and business requirements. iso27001.name: Information security in supplier relationships
iso27001.text: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier's products or services. The organization should identify and impose information security requirements for mitigating the risks associated with supplier's access to the organization's information and information processing facilities. These requirements should be agreed with each supplier that may access, process, store, communicate, or provide IT infrastructure components for the organization's information.

iso27001.name: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
iso27001.text: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship. Agreements with suppliers should include requirements to address the information security risks associated with information and communications technology services and product supply chain. The agreement should include obligations for the supplier to report information security incidents and vulnerabilities.

iso27001.name: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
iso27001.text: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented for managing information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. Requirements relating to information security should be included in agreements with ICT suppliers. The ICT supply chain includes cloud computing services, outsourced development, hardware and software suppliers, and managed service providers.

iso27001.name: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
iso27001.text: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate, and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery. Monitoring and review of supplier services should ensure that information security terms and conditions of agreements are adhered to, and that information security incidents and problems are managed properly. This should involve a service management relationship between the organization and the supplier.

iso27001.name: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
iso27001.text: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use. Prior to disposal or re-use, equipment containing storage media should be checked to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or overwritten. Controls should include physical destruction, secure erasure using approved methods, or encryption with secure key disposal. Certificates of destruction should be obtained.

gdpr.text: Any transfer of personal data which are undergoing processing or are intended for processing after transfer to a third country or to an international organisation shall take place only if the conditions laid down in this Chapter are complied with by the controller and processor.

gdpr.name: Transfers based on adequacy decision
gdpr.text: A transfer of personal data to a third country or an international organisation may take place where the Commission has decided that the third country, a territory or one or more specified sectors within that third country, or the international organisation in question ensures an adequate level of protection.

gdpr.name: Transfers subject to appropriate safeguards
gdpr.text: In the absence of a decision pursuant to Article 45, a controller or processor may transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation only if the controller or processor has provided appropriate safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses or binding corporate rules.

gdpr.text: In the case of a personal data breach, the controller shall without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, notify the personal data breach to the supervisory authority, unless unlikely to result in risk to rights and freedoms.

iso27001.text: Information shall be classified in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality, and sensitivity to unauthorized disclosure or modification. Labels should be easily recognizable and managed throughout the information lifecycle.

iso27001.text: The organization shall evaluate the information security performance and the effectiveness of the information security management system (ISMS). The policy shall include a commitment to satisfy applicable requirements related to information security and a commitment to continual improvement of the information security management system. The information security policy shall be available as documented information, be communicated within the organization, and be available to interested parties, as appropriate.

iso27001.name: Information security objective and planning to achieve them
iso27001.text: The organization shall establish information security objectives at relevant functions and levels. The information security objectives shall be consistent with the information security policy, be measurable (if practicable), take into account applicable information security requirements and the results of risk assessment and risk treatment, be monitored, be communicated, and be updated as appropriate. The organization shall retain documented information on the information security objectives. When planning how to achieve its information security objectives, the organization shall determine what will be done, what resources will be required, who will be responsible, when it will be completed, and how the results will be evaluated.

iso27001.name: Privacy and protection of PII
iso27001.text: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII as required in applicable legislation and regulations and contractual requirements. A data protection officer or equivalent function should be appointed. Privacy by design and by default principles should be implemented. Processing of PII should be documented including purpose, legal basis, retention periods, and data subject rights procedures.

iso27001.name: Terms and conditions of employment
iso27001.text: The employment contractual agreements shall state the personnel's and the organization's responsibilities for information security. Terms and conditions should include responsibilities for information classification, asset management, information handling, use of IT equipment, internet and email, remote working, and actions in case of disregard of security requirements. Information security roles and responsibilities should extend beyond the organization's premises and normal working hours.

iso27001.name: Return of assets
iso27001.text: All organizational assets in the possession of personnel and other interested parties shall be returned upon change or termination of their employment, contract, or agreement. The termination process should be formalized to include the return of all previously issued physical and electronic assets. Where personnel or external party users use personal equipment, procedures should ensure that all relevant information is transferred to the organization and securely deleted from the equipment.

iso27001.name: Access control
iso27001.text: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements. Access control rules should consider the business application requirements and be consistent with the applicable access control policy. Access control should take into account the principle of least privilege and need-to-know, with appropriate segregation of duties.

iso27001.name: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
iso27001.text: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced, and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties. Post-employment obligations should include ongoing confidentiality requirements, return of assets, intellectual property restrictions, and knowledge transfer requirements. Non-compete and non-solicitation clauses should be enforced as applicable. Offboarding procedures should ensure access is revoked.

iso27001.name: Access rights
iso27001.text: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on and rules for access control. Access rights should be aligned with defined access control policies and rules. A formal user access provisioning process should be implemented to assign or revoke access rights for all user types to all systems and services. Access rights of users should be reviewed at regular intervals.

controls.title: Enable 2FA on critical services
controls.description: In order to minimize the threat of someone getting access to something they should not, we follow the **secure principle:** nobody can easily get access to data/systems. We need to ensure that if someone has access to your password, they still cannot log into your account. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) adds extra layers of security by requiring users to provide additional authentication factors beyond their passwords. The most standard solution is 2FA: your password + something else. ## What? Enable 2FA across all your systems. If you don’t want to activate it everywhere, prioritize: - System containing sensitive data - System related to your network, infrastructure or production.

controls.title: Be automatically notified of issues
controls.description: Setting up alerting allows you to respond quickly and minimize downtime or potential data breaches. It ensures that important events, such as unauthorized access or system failures, are addressed promptly. ## What? Don't implement alerts for everything. **Focus on critical events** - if you have alerts on everything, it's not alerting anymore. You should consider (not mandatory or exhaustive): - **Resource Utilization**: Monitor high CPU, memory, or disk usage to prevent downtime or system crashes. - **System Downtime**: Set alerts for system unavailability or critical services going offline. - **Network Traffic Anomalies**: Monitor for unusual spikes or patterns in network traffic that could indicate a potential attack. - **Unauthorized Access Attempts:** Track and alert on failed logins, unusual login locations, or excessive login attempts.

iso27001.name: Networks security
iso27001.text: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed, and controlled to protect information in systems and applications. Controls should be implemented to ensure the security of information in networks and the protection of connected services from unauthorized access. Network management responsibilities and procedures should be established. Network controls should include separation of network services, intrusion detection/prevention, and secure configuration of network devices.

iso27001.name: Configuration management
iso27001.text: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services, and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored, and reviewed. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. Standard configuration templates should be defined for hardware, software, services, and networks. Configuration changes should be controlled through the change management process. Configurations should be monitored and any deviations from the approved baseline should be detected and addressed.

iso27001.name: Independent review of information security
iso27001.text: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals, or when significant changes occur. Independent review should be initiated by management and may be carried out by internal audit functions, independent external parties, or an independent manager. Results of independent reviews should be reported to management and records maintained. Corrective actions should be taken when the independent review identifies that the organization's approach is inadequate.

iso27001.name: Security testing in development and acceptance
iso27001.text: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development lifecycle. Security testing should include both functional security testing and security vulnerability testing. Testing should be performed in a secure test environment that realistically represents the planned operational environment. New systems, updates, and new versions should be thoroughly tested and verified during development and prior to acceptance and deployment.

iso27001.name: Management of technical vulnerabilities
iso27001.text: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated, and appropriate measures shall be taken. A timely response to the identification of potential technical vulnerabilities should be ensured. Vulnerability scans should be performed regularly. Patches should be tested and evaluated before they are installed. A current and complete inventory of assets is a prerequisite for effective technical vulnerability management.

iso27001.name: Physical security perimeters
iso27001.text: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets. Physical protection should be achieved by creating one or more physical barriers around the organization's premises and information processing facilities. The use of the perimeters and the strength of each perimeter should depend on the security requirements of the assets within the perimeter and on the results of a risk assessment.

iso27001.name: Physical security monitoring
iso27001.text: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. Monitoring systems should include CCTV, intrusion detection systems, and alarm systems. Monitoring should be designed to detect and deter unauthorized access attempts. Monitoring data should be reviewed regularly and retained according to organizational policies and legal requirements.

iso27001.name: Security of assets off-premises
iso27001.text: Off-site assets shall be protected. Security measures should be applied to off-site assets taking into account the different risks of working outside the organization's premises. Regardless of ownership, the use of information processing equipment outside the organization's premises should be authorized by management. Equipment and media taken off-premises should not be left unattended in public places. Manufacturer's instructions for protecting equipment should be observed at all times.

iso27001.name: Physical entry
iso27001.text: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access. Access to areas where information and other associated assets are stored and processed should be controlled and restricted to authorized persons only. Authentication controls should be implemented, such as access cards, PINs, or biometrics. Visitor access should be supervised, and entry/exit times recorded.

iso27001.name: Working in secure areas
iso27001.text: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented. Controls should consider that personnel should only be aware of the existence of, or activities within, a secure area on a need-to-know basis. Unsupervised working in secure areas should be avoided both for safety reasons and to prevent opportunities for malicious activities. Vacant secure areas should be physically locked and periodically checked.
